summary: The filing is a routine Form 8-K by Adams Street Credit Solutions Fund covering an unregistered sale of Class I shares in its continuous private offering, and a monthly distribution declaration. Approximately 83,485.841 Class I shares were sold for $1.7 million at $20.17 NAV per share as of July 31, 2026. A $0.15 per share distribution for August 2026 was declared, payable September 9, 2026. No special-situation event; this is standard monthly reporting and is not classified as a special situation.
